fieldValues.title: Which carriers should SRS define, and how does a reader find the payload?
fieldValues.thinking_reached: Raised by the 2026-11-27 carrier prototypes (Research: SRS carriers, part 1). No option chosen.
fieldValues.tensions:
Options, none chosen:
- A. PDF/A-3 only, as the archival carrier: /AF with AFRelationship /Source, an SRS media type, an XMP binding.
- B. A carrier binding per format (PDF, HTML, EPUB, DOCX), each with one rule for locating the payload, as a spec extension.
- C. No spec change yet: a SemanticOps tool convention, specified once a second user asks.
fieldValues.unresolved_questions: Whether anyone outside the programme wants SRS inside a document they already use; how each format survives ordinary tools (Ghostscript already strips PDF attachments); whether HTML or DOCX carriers can be kept from drifting.
fieldValues.next_action: Build an HTML carrier from the same essay slice and test both in common viewers and editors; show the minutes PDF to the next demo user.
